notes.title: Your pizzas can be equipped in-game!
notes.content:
[h3]👋Hey everyone![/h3]
In today's update, we've added the function to equip your pizza skins in-game! 

Don't forget to join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/WqE6X2RRuu]Discord server[/url] to receive all the latest updates and help create new pizzas! 🍕

[h3][b]📋CHANGELOG[/b][/h3]
[b]INVENTORY[/b]
◽ Pizzas can be selected as skins
◽ Pizzas can be deleted
◽ Pizzas are now stacked
[b]UI[/b]
◽ Changed pizza counter's format
◽ Changed upgrades format

notes.title: 🍕 Four new pizzas in the item store!
notes.content:
In today's update, we've replaced the old item store pizzas with 4 new ones!
Enjoy!

notes.title: Hotfix 14/07
notes.content: The game should no longer freeze when loading inventory items.

notes.title: 🍕 Three new drops and an in-game inventory 🍕
notes.content:
[h3]👋Hey everyone![/h3]
In today's update, we've finally added the inventory, which can be accessed from the bottom left icon. We removed the 2 limited-time pizzas and [b]added 3 new ones[/b], all designed by our incredible [url=https://discord.com/invite/WqE6X2RRuu]Discord members[/url] [i]Ogujan[/i], [i]BigWorm [/i]and [i]Ionica[/i]! 🍕

[h3]⚠️Important[/h3]
Tomorrow, we'll swap the Steam shop items with new ones, so if you haven't done so, go and get them while you still can!

[h3][b]📋CHANGELOG[/b][/h3]
[b]DROPS[/b]
◽ Added 3 new pizzas
◽ Removed 2 limited-time pizzas

[b]UI[/b]
◽ The inventory of items has been added in-game

notes.title: Hotfix 11/07
notes.content:
[b]GAMEPLAY[/b]
[list]
[*]The game window can now be freely resized
[*]The "BURP" button is correctly aligned across different aspect ratios
[/list]
[b]SAVES[/b]
[list]
[*]There should no longer be any problems with save files getting corrupted by large numbers
[/list]

[url=https://discord.com/invite/WqE6X2RRuu]Join our Discord![/url] We'll be hosting a giveaway once we reach 100 members

notes.title: Five new pizzas have been added to the drop pool!
notes.content:
Hi everyone, today we're adding five new pizzas to the drop pool, one of which was made by Ogujan from our [url=https://discord.com/invite/WqE6X2RRuu]Discord server[/url] (join us, and you can make one too!)

Out of these five pizzas, Pizza Vaporwave and Pizza Matrix are limited-time drops, so be careful because they'll be gone in 3 days, on Sunday the 14th at 4 PM CET!

Stay tuned for a hotfix later today that will fix some minor code issues.

Happy collecting!

notes.title: Patch #1 - New items, upgrades and fixes!
notes.content:
Hi everyone, we're releasing the first patch for Pizzeria which includes some QoL changes, new upgrades and various fixes. We're also removing the "First Pizza" drop and adding three new items to the drop pool. Expect new updates and items to be released in the coming days!

Remember to [url=https://discord.com/invite/WqE6X2RRuu]join our Discord[/url] for updates, pizza suggestions and special giveaways!

Changelog:

[b]DROPS[/b]
[list]
[*] Added "Pizza Pedro", "Pizza Vinyl" and "Pizza Low Poly" to the drop pool
[*] Removed "The First Pizza"
[*] Changed the drop rate of the "Pizza" item
[/list]
[b]GAMEPLAY[/b]
[list]
[*] Added two upgrades
[*] Decreased beer event chance of happening
[/list]
[b]UI[/b]
[list]
[*] Changed the way upgrades effects are displayed
[*] Changed upgrades colors
[/list]

notes.title: Pizzeria Release Day!
notes.content:
We are excited to announce that our game is now available!

To celebrate the launch, [b]everyone[/b] will be able to drop an [b]exclusive limited item[/b]. Also, remember that when we reach 100 members, we'll be doing a giveaway for [url=https://discord.com/invite/WqE6X2RRuu]Discord[/url] members and early birds.

New updates will be coming in the next few days that will add new exclusive items, in-game upgrades, features, and much more. So follow us, [url=https://discord.com/invite/WqE6X2RRuu]join our Discord[/url], and stay tuned.

[i]Have fun eating pizza![/i]
